(2) Missing line: the General Fund budgetary schedule (p8) prints General government Actual '-' (budget 211,670) and Total charges to appropriations 388,814 (= Public safety 130,943 + Environment and leisure 206,815 + Capital outlay 51,056), while the p4 General Fund column prints General government 185,376 and Total expenditures 574,190 (574,190 - 388,814 = 185,376; all other General Fund lines agree between the two pages). The 185,376 is added from the p4 General Fund column. 853,984 + 38,208 + 185,376 = 1,077,568 = statement total.
